hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for v4.fun pools. Charges ETH fees between 1–7% on buys (via beforeSwap BeforeSwapDelta on input) and sells (via afterSwap delta on output), with the fee scaling linearly based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent immediately to a per-pool feeRecipient; only exact-input swaps are allowed.
